import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long mo;
    static class ModInt {
        long v;
        public ModInt(long a) {
            v = a;
            if (mo != 0 && (v >= mo || v < 0)) {
                v = (v % mo + mo) % mo;
            }
        }
        public static ModInt pow(ModInt a, long n) {
            long b = a.v, r = 1;
            while (n > 0) {
                if ((n & 1) == 1) r = r * b % mo;
                b = b * b % mo;
                n >>= 1;
            }
            return new ModInt(r);
        }
        public ModInt plus(ModInt a) {
            long res = v + a.v;
            if (res >= mo) res -= mo;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }
        public ModInt minus(ModInt a) {
            long res = v - a.v;
            if (res < 0) res += mo;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }
        public ModInt times(ModInt a) {
            return new ModInt(v * a.v % mo);
        }
        public ModInt div(ModInt a) {
            assert a.v != 0;
            return this.times(pow(a, mo - 2));
        }
        public String toString() {
            return Long.toString(v);
        }
    }

    static int N, M;
    static ModInt[] dp1 = new ModInt[505];
    static ModInt[] dp2 = new ModInt[505];
    static ModInt[][] dp3 = new ModInt[505][505];
    static ModInt[][] dp4 = new ModInt[505][505];

    static long comb(long N_, long C_) {
        final int NUM_ = 400001;
        static long[] fact = new long[NUM_ + 1];
        static long[] factr = new long[NUM_ + 1];
        static long[] inv = new long[NUM_ + 1];
        if (fact[0] == 0) {
            inv[1] = fact[0] = factr[0] = 1;
            for (int i = 2; i <= NUM_; i++) {
                inv[i] = inv[(int)(mo % i)] * (mo - mo / i) % mo;
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= NUM_; i++) {
                fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % mo;
                factr[i] = factr[i - 1] * inv[i] % mo;
            }
        }
        if (C_ < 0 || C_ > N_) return 0;
        return factr[(int)C_] * fact[(int)N_] % mo * factr[(int)(N_ - C_)] % mo;
    }

    public static void solve() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        M = sc.nextInt();
        mo = sc.nextLong();

        for (int i = 0; i <= 504; i++) {
            dp1[i] = new ModInt(0);
            dp2[i] = new ModInt(0);
            Arrays.fill(dp3[i], new ModInt(0));
            Arrays.fill(dp4[i], new ModInt(0));
        }

        dp1[0] = new ModInt(1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                ModInt term1 = new ModInt(i + 1).times(dp1[j - 1]).times(dp1[i - j]).times(new ModInt(comb(i - 1, j - 1)));
                dp1[i] = dp1[i].plus(term1);

                ModInt term2a = dp2[i - j].times(dp1[j - 1]);
                ModInt term2b = dp1[i - j].times(dp2[j - 1]);
                ModInt term2 = new ModInt(i + 1).times(term2a.plus(term2b)).times(new ModInt(comb(i - 1, j - 1)));
                dp2[i] = dp2[i].plus(term2);

                ModInt term3 = dp1[j - 1].times(dp1[i - j]).times(new ModInt(comb(i - 1, j - 1))).times(new ModInt(comb(j - 1 + 1, 2) + comb(i - j + 1, 2)));
                dp2[i] = dp2[i].plus(term3);
            }
        }

        dp3[0][0] = new ModInt(1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                dp3[i][j] = dp3[i - 1][j];
                dp4[i][j] = dp4[i - 1][j];
                for (int l = 1; l <= j; l++) {
                    ModInt c = new ModInt(comb(j, l));
                    dp3[i][j] = dp3[i][j].plus(dp1[l].times(dp3[i - l - 1][j - l]).times(c));
                    dp4[i][j] = dp4[i][j].plus(dp1[l].times(dp4[i - l - 1][j - l]).plus(dp2[l].times(dp3[i - l - 1][j - l]))).times(c));
                }
            }
            dp3[i][i] = new ModInt(i);
            dp4[i][i] = new ModInt(i);
        }

        System.out.println(dp4[N][M]);
        sc.close();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        solve();
    }
}
